source.title: Transient temperature, pressure, and flow characteristics of high-pressure hydrogen-containing mixtures during discharge from an orifice
source.abstract_only_observation: The new apparatus is reported for a 0.7 H2 + 0.3 CO2 mole-fraction mixture through a needle valve; pure-H2 validation is described as reuse of existing literature data.

required_for_numerical_holdout: supplement provides reusable numerical time-series rather than plotted images only
common time base for source pressure and source temperature
terminal mass flow or cumulative released mass on the same time base
source volume, initial pressure and initial temperature
needle-valve or effective terminal restriction geometry and valve actuation semantics
at least four independent cases spanning at least two initial-pressure groups
license or publisher terms permit local reproducible analysis
preaccess_eligibility.mixture_domain_rule: The frozen production model is pure-H2. A 0.7 H2 + 0.3 CO2 outcome cannot be scored as pure-H2 HRS validation unless a mixture-property implementation is frozen before numerical outcome access. Without that implementation it is metadata or development evidence only.
preaccess_eligibility.independence_rule: Existing pure-H2 literature curves reused by the article are ineligible when they duplicate Sakoda/PRESLHY or any other dataset already inspected in this repository.

prohibited_after_numerical_access: treating H2-CO2 mixture traces as pure hydrogen
claim_boundary: This protocol freezes an intake decision before opening the publisher supplement. It is not a validation result and does not alter any current IJHE readiness gate.
